## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: (1) Very narrow sector breadth (only Technology and Energy showing 1W strength) and (2) top-performer concentration into Tech/Energy (Leadership: Narrow, 3/5 Technology), so a neutral stance with caution on concentration.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology lead: CRM (1W: +23.19% | 1M: +39.95%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +15.57% | 1M: +33.05%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +5.90% | 1M: +9.98%) ABOVE TREND. Energy also leading: SLB (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +22.88%) ABOVE TREND, WMB (1W: +6.47% | 1M: +5.84%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Consumer Discretionary lagging: PYPL (1W: -14.62% | 1M: -7.94%) BELOW TREND, RCL (1W: -7.97% | 1M: -16.52%) BELOW TREND. Healthcare weak: UNH (1W: -0.18% | 1M: -7.61%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -7.86% | 1M: +0.30%) CORRECTION. Industrials weak: BA (1W: -3.00% | 1M: -5.94%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: CRM (1W: +23.19% | 1M: +39.95%) ABOVE TREND; NOW (1W: +15.57% | 1M: +33.05%) ABOVE TREND; SLB (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +22.88%) ABOVE TREND; PANW (1W: +6.78% | 1M: +17.33%) ABOVE TREND; WMB (1W: +6.47% | 1M: +5.84%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology) — concentration risk.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: PYPL (1W: -14.62% | 1M: -7.94%) BELOW TREND; TTWO (1W: -8.31% | 1M: -11.21%) BELOW TREND; RCL (1W: -7.97% | 1M: -16.52%) BELOW TREND; AMAT (1W: -6.89% | 1M: -8.55%) BELOW TREND; LOW (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -2.56%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in select high-volatility names and consumer names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W movers: CRM (1W: +23.19%), NOW (1W: +15.57%), SLB (1W: +11.56%). Negative momentum to monitor: PYPL (1W: -14.62%) and TTWO (1W: -8.31%). Major divergence present (≥3 sizeable names with 1W vs 1M sign changes) — watch for trend breaks rather than broad regime shifts.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed but leading internally; key names ABOVE TREND: CRM (1W: +23.19% | 1M: +39.95%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +15.57% | 1M: +33.05%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +5.90% | 1M: +9.98%) ABOVE TREND; weakness in select names: AMAT (1W: -6.89% | 1M: -8.55%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -2.50% | 1M: -4.71%) BELOW TREND. Sector positive in the current week but narrow leadership; overall breadth contributes to NEUTRAL.

8. Financials Outlook?
Large-cap Financials showing resilience but sector soft; JPM (1W: +1.26% | 1M: +1.47%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +2.25% | 1M: +3.77%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +1.49% | 1M: +2.07%) ABOVE TREND while overall Financials 1W is negative — look for selective strength among big caps.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Patchy and mostly weak; PFE (1W: +1.39% | 1M: +14.25%) ABOVE TREND, but UNH (1W: -0.18% | 1M: -7.61%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: -7.86% | 1M: +0.30%) CORRECTION, indicating headline-driven dispersion and defensive frictions.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor names showing clear ABOVE TREND momentum (CRM, NOW, SLB) and reduce exposure to outliers with severe 1W declines (PYPL, TTWO, RCL). Style: mixed / no clear leadership given narrow tech/energy concentration and weak overall breadth; remain selective and monitor major divergence.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: CRM (1W: +23.19% | 1M: +39.95%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +15.57% | 1M: +33.05%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +11.56% | 1M: +22.88%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: PYPL (1W: -14.62% | 1M: -7.94%) BELOW TREND, TTWO (1W: -8.31% | 1M: -11.21%) BELOW TREND, LOW (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -2.56%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology and Energy (the two 1W positive sectors; watch leadership concentration). BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary and Healthcare where multiple large components show downside or corrections.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Monitor continuation above recent swing highs for NVDA (1W: +5.90% | 1M: +9.98%) ABOVE TREND and CRM (1W: +23.19% | 1M: +39.95%) ABOVE TREND for momentum confirmation; watch PYPL 1W low and TTWO weekly breakdowns as triggers for further downside; a rebound in Financials big caps (JPM, V) would be an early sign of broader risk-on.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
NVDA (+55): Nvidia just announced a $3.5B AI expansion — NVDA (1W: +5.90% | 1M: +9.98%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirming price. EMR (+55): industrial backlog headline — EMR not in detailed view here; monitor for confirmation in price action.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
AMZN (-60): FTC lawsuit headline — AMZN (1W: -0.88% | 1M: -4.35%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirming pressure. PYPL (-55): analyst cuts on deal hopes — PYPL (1W: -14.62% | 1M: -7.94%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirming distribution. AAPL (-50): CEO/headline concerns — AAPL (1W: +2.10% | 1M: +2.66%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment diverging from price, watch for distribution.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership given narrow Tech/Energy concentration. CRM, NOW, SLB showing relative strength and are ABOVE TREND while PYPL and TTWO show clear weakness. Key risk is concentrated leadership and multiple headline-driven divergences (sentiment vs price) — watch for trend confirmation before increasing exposure.
